item.title: Kerala-Chennai trains to get brand new coaches from February: Report
item.description: The Indian Railways has finally given the green signal to the long–term demand of Keralites for modern railway coaches that are clean and boast of advanced safety features in trains to Kerala. item.title: Ahmedabad to get eight new flyovers by next year, 12 bridges by 2028
item.description: Ahmedabad is set to see major traffic relief as eight new flyovers are scheduled to become operational within the next year.
